mechanism: Vitamin K may reduce the anticoagulant effect of warfarin which is sometimes co-prescribed with simvastatin, and simvastatin may increase vitamin K metabolism through CYP3A4 induction, potentially affecting coagulation status in patients on anticoagulation therapy.
action: Monitor INR closely if patient is on concurrent warfarin therapy; maintain consistent vitamin K intake and counsel patient on dietary vitamin K consistency; no dose adjustment typically needed for simvastatin monotherapy.
